chain.text:
**Context**: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms, 12 nurses, 4 admin.
**Hours**: 08:00–19:00 weekdays; 09:00–13:00 Saturday.
**Accreditation**: Held since April 2022; expires April 2027; renewal needs infection-control audit.
**Demand**: 180 consultations/day average; 310 peak (January 2025 flu wave).
**No-shows**: 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.
**Fridge incident**: March 2024 failure lost €2,100 stock; networked alarm plus paper log now.
**Records incident**: November 2024 concurrent edit overwrote allergy field; records now lock when open.
**Rule**: No renewal without consultation within 12 months (38 breaches found).
**Rule**: Vaccine stock counted twice weekly.
**Rule**: Excursions above 8°C reported same day to regional agency.
**Ultrasound**: Second machine postponed June 2025 pending utilisation study; not done.
**Vacancy**: Coordinator post vacant since August 2025; two senior nurses rotating; unsustainable beyond winter.
